name: Darthalia's Sealed Commendation
summary: At Tarren Mill, Darthalia sends word of victories against Hillsbrad's human defenders to Undercity's high command.

sections.title: Report to High Command
sections.body: After the fighting in Hillsbrad Foothills, High Executor Darthalia seals a dispatch of victories against the human defenders and the ruin of their positions. She sends it to Varimathras, the dreadlord who advises Lady Sylvanas Windrunner. In Undercity's Royal Quarter, the report gives Forsaken leaders proof that Alliance enclaves south of Lordaeron can be broken. Then northern garrisons can turn to face the Scourge.

faq.answer: At Tarren Mill, High Executor Darthalia writes a sealed commendation for a fighter's performance against the Alliance in the Battle of Hillsbrad. She sends it to Undercity's high command.

aliases: who do i bring this to
faq.answer: Varimathras receives the commendation. He is the dreadlord advisor to Lady Sylvanas Windrunner in Undercity's Royal Quarter.

faq.q: Why does Varimathras care about the fighting in Hillsbrad?
faq.answer: The Forsaken face the Lich King and his Scourge to the north. Meanwhile, Hillsbrad's humans disrupt their supply lines and southern border security. Varimathras values victories that remove this obstacle and free Undercity's forces to focus on the greater war.

angles.text: For the Horde, the commendation records a strategic victory in Lordaeron. It shows Undercity's leadership that Alliance strongholds in the southern foothills can be dismantled.
As an Undead, you raise your standing in the Dark Lady's growing military hierarchy by earning Darthalia's praise and bringing the commendation to the throne room.
